name: Auctus
fix_description: In _sellACOTokens, the _exchange.call{value}(exchangeData) performs an arbitrary external call with user-controlled data. Add reentrancy guard and validate the exchange address against a whitelist.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a single-call exploit with a very obvious arbitrary-call/injection pattern: `acowrite.write` is abused to execute a crafted `transferFrom` payload and drain approved USDC. It requires minimal protocol-specific knowledge, no flash loans or multi-step state manipulation, and the PoC is short and straightforward.
